rules.name: cs-13-leg-rounding-all-clients-cfs
rules.sql: WITH legs AS ( SELECT c.client_code, regexp_replace(c.contract_number, '[ABCR]$', '') AS contract_key, round(c.traded_price::numeric, 6) AS price, round(c.future_price::numeric, 6) AS edsp, c.mtm_usd::numeric AS mtm_usd FROM opera.helper_client_statement_report_view_cache_table c WHERE c.tenant_id = :tenant AND c.business_unit = 'CFS' AND c.value_date = :valueDate AND c.derivative_type = 'future' ), r AS ( SELECT client_code, contract_key, price, edsp, count(*) AS legs, round(sum(mtm_usd), 2) AS exact_sum, sum(round(mtm_usd, 2)) AS leg_rounded_sum FROM legs GROUP BY 1, 2, 3, 4 ) SELECT client_code, count(*) AS swap_rows, count(*) FILTER (WHERE exact_sum <> leg_rounded_sum) AS rows_that_would_change, sum(leg_rounded_sum - exact_sum) AS total_change, max(legs) AS max_legs_in_a_row FROM r GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 3 DESC, 1

WITH legs AS ( SELECT c.client_code, regexp_replace(c.contract_number, '[ABCR]$', '') AS contract_key, round(c.traded_price::numeric, 6) AS price, round(c.future_price::numeric, 6) AS edsp, c.mtm_usd::numeric AS mtm_usd FROM opera.helper_client_statement_report_view_cache_table c WHERE c.tenant_id = :tenant AND c.business_unit = 'CFS' AND c.value_date = :valueDate AND c.derivative_type = 'future' ) SELECT client_code, contract_key, price, edsp, count(*) AS legs, round(sum(mtm_usd), 2) AS exact_sum, sum(round(mtm_usd, 2)) AS leg_rounded_sum FROM legs GROUP BY 1, 2, 3, 4 HAVING round(sum(mtm_usd), 2) <> sum(round(mtm_usd, 2)) ORDER BY 1, 2, 3

expect.reason: CFS swap rows exist on the value date
